005package org.wpilib.hardware.bus;
006
007/**
008 * CAN port mapping.
009 *
010 * <p>S0-S4 are Systemcore CAN buses. D0-D19 are Motioncore CAN buses.
011 */
012public enum CANPort {
013  /** CAN port S0. */
014  CAN_S0(0),
015  /** CAN port S1. */
016  CAN_S1(1),
017  /** CAN port S2. */
018  CAN_S2(2),
019  /** CAN port S3. */
020  CAN_S3(3),
021  /** CAN port S4. */
022  CAN_S4(4),
023  /** CAN port D0. */
024  CAN_D0(5),
025  /** CAN port D1. */
026  CAN_D1(6),
027  /** CAN port D2. */
028  CAN_D2(7),
029  /** CAN port D3. */
030  CAN_D3(8),
031  /** CAN port D4. */
032  CAN_D4(9),
033  /** CAN port D5. */
034  CAN_D5(10),
035  /** CAN port D6. */
036  CAN_D6(11),
037  /** CAN port D7. */
038  CAN_D7(12),
039  /** CAN port D8. */
040  CAN_D8(13),
041  /** CAN port D9. */
042  CAN_D9(14),
043  /** CAN port D10. */
044  CAN_D10(15),
045  /** CAN port D11. */
046  CAN_D11(16),
047  /** CAN port D12. */
048  CAN_D12(17),
049  /** CAN port D13. */
050  CAN_D13(18),
051  /** CAN port D14. */
052  CAN_D14(19),
053  /** CAN port D15. */
054  CAN_D15(20),
055  /** CAN port D16. */
056  CAN_D16(21),
057  /** CAN port D17. */
058  CAN_D17(22),
059  /** CAN port D18. */
060  CAN_D18(23),
061  /** CAN port D19. */
062  CAN_D19(24);
063
064  /** CAN port ID. */
065  public final int value;
066
067  CANPort(int value) {
068    this.value = value;
069  }
070}
